Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios

Instruction SRAM. SIM compiles a stand-in array for cocotb. The GDS flow does not define SIM, so the netlist keeps the empty macro and MACROS supplies its LEF, GDS, and timing library. The fast liberty file is characterized at -55 C and is the closest file to the -40 C corner the flow asks for. pdn_cfg.tcl vias the SRAM Metal4 supply columns up to the TopMetal1 straps. Magic DRC does not understand the SRAM bit cells (279091 false errors); the shuttle precheck is KLayout, which does. The macro sits at x=5.815 so a TopMetal1 track (pitch 3.28, offset 1.64) lands on the first VDD column center. Strap spacing 3.52 plus width 2.1 is the 5.62 um from a VDD column center to the next VSS column center. Pitch 45.92 is 14 tracks, so later straps stay on the TopMetal1 grid.
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
